summary.result: The results indicate that many agricultural reservoirs may contribute to controlling flood in the small watersheds during the flood season.
summary.background: We investigated flood control capacity of 484 agricultural reservoirs with storage capacity of over 1 million $m^3$ in South Korea.
summary.method: The study reservoirs showed flood control capacity of 0.60-65 billion (B) $m^3$ and stable flood control capacity of 0.43-47 B $m^3$ , depending on the upper and lower limited water levels during the flood season.
